evidence.reason: The cited assertion only checks that stdout contains the substring `queue lock busy`. The current contract's I1 output rule requires every operation invocation to write machine-readable JSON on stdout and narration on stderr, never mixed. A plain-text or mixed stdout containing that phrase would still satisfy this test, so the test does not verify the required JSON-only output shape. Parsing the entire captured stdout as JSON and then checking the diagnostic is the smallest compatible repair; the exit-code assertion can remain.
